<!--

issue_context.body:

-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
ConnectionState errors pop up in the HA log, see below, and I have no idea what configuration causes it or why it happens

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Configuration -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.115.2
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 0.114 (at least I do not recall those messages in the log)
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): Homeassistant / Supervised
- Integration causing this issue: xknx
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/knx/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
knx:
  state_updater: true
  fire_event: true
  fire_event_filter: ["2/*/*","10/*/*"]
  expose:
    - type: 'time'
      address: '5/0/250'
    - type: 'datetime'
      address: '5/0/251'
  binary_sensor: !include_dir_merge_list knx/binary_sensors/
  sensor: !include_dir_merge_list knx/sensors/
  switch: !include_dir_merge_list knx/switches/
  cover: !include_dir_merge_list knx/covers/
  light: !include_dir_merge_list knx/lights/
  climate: !include_dir_merge_list knx/climate/
```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
Logger: xknx.log
Source: /usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/xknx/io/request_response.py:64
First occurred: 23. September 2020, 12:02:31 (141 occurrences)
Last logged: 09:02:38

    Error: KNX bus responded to request of type 'ConnectionState' with error in 'ConnectionStateResponse': ErrorCode.E_CONNECTION_ID
    Error: KNX bus responded to request of type 'Disconnect' with error in 'DisconnectResponse': ErrorCode.E_CONNECTION_ID
```
and this
```txt
Logger: xknx.log
Source: /usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/xknx/io/tunnel.py:250
First occurred: 23. September 2020, 12:03:16 (29 occurrences)
Last logged: 09:17:47
Heartbeat failed - reconnecting 
```
## Additional information
let me know if you need more information
comments:
Hey there @julius2342, @farmio, @marvin-w, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`knx`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L228) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

We'll need more information. Please set loglevel of "xknx.log" to debug. 
Can you reproduce this?

@farmio what do you mean with `can you reproduce this?` It's a recurring error as it is stated in the posted log (141 occurrences at that time, ofc still counting).

As for the loglevel `debug`. Is there a way to have the xknx logs in a separate file? I don't want to post my entire HA log as it appears that it also contains access tokes and what not.
@da-anda I am not aware of such an option, but each log line specifies where it is coming from, so you could easily remove everything without "xknx" in the line.

well, the file went up to 10 MB pretty quickly, so took me some time to find a way on how to automatically filter for anything xknx and anything with `body="<..."` since you very likely also need the message body data.

So here you go; https://paste.kodi.tv/legogadoke.kodi

<s>@farminf  @marvin-w You are more up-to-date, but shouldn't HA 0.115.2 (where apparently according to OP  the issue occurs) have a newer XKNX version above 0.13.0?</s>
Never mind, HA 0.115.2 actually contains 0.13.0. The 0.14.x are in the recent HA 0.116.0 dev version.
I am running 0.115.2 using Homeassistant/HassOS/Supervised (or whatever you wanna call it) on a RPI4

There is a configuration to have sane logs:
https://community.home-assistant.io/t/knx-cookbook/104707/50?u=farmio

```yaml
logger:
  default: info
  logs:
    xknx.log: debug
```

@farmio Yes, but it is still the same log file = you cannot send log entries from certain components to separate log files. 

But back to topic...

I guess > 250 GAs are too much, so the rate limiter chokes. This should be fixed with the next release of xknx: https://github.com/XKNX/xknx/pull/364 
Please report back if it didn't!

@farmio thanks for having a look at my log. But how would 250 GAs be too much? I haven't even added all the diagnostic GAs, lock GAs and what not, so it's going to get a lot more.

I would understand issues on startup when xknx tries to update/read the current states of everything, but it's not like it has to constantly poll every GA in order to get updates since changes are pushed/announced on the bus, so it only has to listen. And it also only has to listen to state GAs and sensors, not to GAs that trigger/send actions (cover up/down, tilt, switches). So the actual number of GAs to monitor (and not even actively do read requests) is way lower.
If XKNX is permanently polling for GA states, than this IMO would be a bad design and there should be a setting to enable polling per state GA or entity type (with default off, since AFAIK on any sane KNX setup polling should not really be required).

Nevertheless I will ofc keep you posted if the issues still exist in HA 0.116.0 / XKNX 0.14.x

You can live a no-poll-at startup life if you prefer by disabling state_updater 
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/knx/
Be aware that your entities will not be initialized correctly, but it may be worth a try until 0.116 is released. 
Or you run a HA 0.116 dev version and help us further fixing this bug.

I have this since 114 on a rather large system(Classroom with 8 homelynks/8baos and over 200 devices). 

Following this with caution.

> You can live a no-poll-at startup life if you prefer by disabling state_updater
> https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/knx/
> Be aware that your entities will not be initialized correctly, but it may be worth a try until 0.116 is released.
> Or you run a HA 0.116 dev version and help us further fixing this bug.

I am not concerned about issues at startup, but as this is a recurring error every X minutes, I wonder what XKNX is doing in the background to cause this, since it should not have to actively poll any GA

so I updated to HA 0.116.0b0 (running XKNX v0.15.0) and the issue unfortunately still persists, at least on startup (in case that should be fixed by 0.15.0 as well). I am currently grabbing a debug log, but it might take a bit for the recurring issues to show up again

It disconnects and reconnects a lot, but there is never 1 telegram received. Are these full logs or  is this filtered?

Why has your tunneling device the same IP address as your HA Server?

it is filtered in the way that I removed all log lines that did not have "xknx" in it - but other than that it's the full debug log.

> Why has your tunneling device the same IP address as your HA Server?

because I only have a USB interface and I use my knxd HA add-on ( https://community.home-assistant.io/t/knxd-add-on-covert-your-knx-usb-interface-into-an-ip-interface-that-can-be-used-by-ha/38108 ) to make it an IP interface that can be used by XKNX and which I can use in ETS remotely.
